@jasdye I won't add to it by typing it out, but it's the cops' racist response to #BLM

#Station19 managed to integrate the best non-Lee family depiction of mixed Asian American experience into an epic episode of the #BLM fight and it all had me crying. 

#Station19 has been an anti-venom for copaganda on TV. 

Now we just need a discussion of Abolitionism on there.

Some may say that this will divide our @AFTUnion. The same people said the same thing about standing against the dehumanization of Black students by supporting #BLM. Those people were wrong then and they are wrong now. We may be divided politically, but justice is not political.

Much love to the Floyd Family. 

Also, the absolutely minimum that Biden needs to do to get to replacement level is pardoning all of the victims of mass incarceration and integrating schools.
